text: Roll the block with the arrow keys or WASD.
Stand it upright on the goal hole to clear the stage.
Be careful not to fall off the edges!
Bridges and switches are located in many levels.
The switches are activated by when being pressed down by the block.
You don't need to stay on the switches to keep the brigdes closed.
When activated, each switch may behave differently.
Some will toggle the bridges from open to closed to open.
Some will only open the bridges, pressing them again will not make them close.
There are 2 types of switches: 'Heavy' X-shaped and 'Solf' round shaped.
Solf switches are activated when any part of your block press it.
Heavy switches require more pressure. They are only activated when your block is standing on theirs end.
Orange tiles are more fragile than the rest of the land.
If you stand up vertically on an orange tile, it will give way and you will fall.
There is also a 3rd kind of switch that is shaped like ( ).
It teleports you to a different locations, splitting your block into 2 smaller blocks at the same time.
They can be controlled individually and will rejoin into a normal block when they touch.
You can switch control between your split cubes with [Space].
